title: Positive mass on every open neighbourhood of a support point (general fact G3)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), W ⊆ ℝ^P open and x ∈ W with x ∈ spt T. Then M_W(T) > 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P), IsOpen U → IsOpen W → x ∈ W → x ∈ T.support → 0 < T.massOn W
